input.raw_text: Mila and Tala were cousins and they were both eleven. Mila had short hair and Tala always wore a red hair tie. One rainy afternoon they were bored in Lola's kitchen and Tala found an old bamboo fan behind the rice bin. It was plain and brown and a little dusty. They ran out to the yard to shake the dust off it but the rain was still falling so they came back inside. Lola said the fan belonged to her mother and nobody had used it in years. Mila got the paints from the cabinet and they painted white sampaguita flowers all over the fan, one flower each, taking turns. Tala got paint on her red hair tie and Mila laughed at her. When it dried they fanned Lola with it at the kitchen table. Lola said it was prettier now than when it was new.

timeline.summary: Mila and Tala, two eleven-year-old cousins, are bored in Lola's kitchen on a rainy afternoon.
Tala finds an old bamboo fan behind the rice bin, and they take it outside to shake off the dust but return because of the rain.
Lola tells them the fan belonged to her mother and hasn't been used in years.
Mila and Tala paint white sampaguita flowers on the fan, taking turns, and Tala gets paint on her red hair tie.
After the paint dries, they fan Lola with the decorated fan, and she says it is prettier now.
